title: Layout creator
subtitle: Paste a video link, pick the parts of the frame to show, and save the layout to use when you create clips.
timeHint: Load a moment where the webcam and the game are both visible. YouTube links only for now.
noFrame: Load a preview to start drawing the layout.
frameAlt: Frame of the video with the crops drawn over it
dragHint: Drag a box to move it, or drag its corner to resize. The shape follows the panel, so you see exactly what is kept.
splitLabel: Top panel takes {percent}% of the height
